gate: Gate 1: Authentic OAuth login and BFF session verification
testMethod: Database query on staging bff_sessions and users for authentic OAuth principals; v2 BFF token serialization; preview unauthenticated rejection check.
expectedResult: Active non-revoked session records with future expiry, cryptographic token format, and 401 unauthenticated fail-closed rejection.
actualResult: Verified authentic Principal A ([REDACTED_STAGING_PRINCIPAL_A_EMAIL], ID: [REDACTED]) and Principal B ([REDACTED_STAGING_PRINCIPAL_B_EMAIL], ID: [REDACTED]) with active unrevoked BFF sessions. Unauthenticated probe returned HTTP 401.

gate: Gate 2: Cross-account conversation and project isolation
testMethod: Bidirectional conversation synchronization and cross-account IDOR read/delete attempts on live preview deployment.
expectedResult: Owners read own conversations (200); foreign principals receive 404 on reads and 403/404 on deletion attempts.
actualResult: Bidirectional IDOR isolation confirmed: User B -> User A returned read 404, delete 404; User A -> User B returned read 404, delete 404.
httpStatus: Sync: 200 / Read: 200 / IDOR Read: 404 / IDOR Delete: 404

gate: Gate 3: Memory retrieval, import, export, and deletion
testMethod: Memory engine client vault isolation test across Staging Principal A and Staging Principal B principals, verifying memory creation, recall quarantine, foreign import rejection, and deletion.
expectedResult: Memories isolated by authentic user ID; cross-account recall returns 0; foreign import rejected (0 imported, 1 error); deletion succeeds cleanly.
actualResult: Vault isolation confirmed: Raj memory (mem-s-1794206776...) quarantined from Khanh; Khanh memory (mem-s-1794206776...) quarantined from Raj; both foreign import attempts rejected; clean deletion verified.

gate: Gate 4: Autonomous task ownership and status
testMethod: Bidirectional autonomous task creation, status read, and cross-account cancellation denial on live deployed preview API.
expectedResult: Owners read own task (200); foreign accounts cannot read (403/404) or cancel (403) tasks.
actualResult: Task isolation verified: User B -> Task A read=403, cancel=403; User A -> Task B read=403, cancel=403.
httpStatus: Create: 200 / Read: 200 / IDOR Read: 403 / IDOR Cancel: 403

gate: Gate 5: Agent execution and SSE streaming under both identities
testMethod: Real-time SSE chat streaming on deployed preview with live calculator tool execution and cryptographic model provenance validation under both Account A and Account B.
expectedResult: Distinct run IDs, tool completion with exact mathematical results, verified model provenance, non-mock provider execution.
actualResult: Live SSE streaming verified: Account A runId=run_ed1b6afc-7... computed 4194304 (groq); Account B runId=run_7db76d6b-7... computed 2097152 (groq). Both verified: true.
httpStatus: HTTP 200 / SSE Stream Finished / Tool Execution Verified

gate: Gate 6: Tool permission and approval enforcement
testMethod: Evaluation of tool registry access, authorized tool execution, and unapproved/unregistered tool rejection on deployed preview.
expectedResult: Unauthenticated access denied (401); authorized tool executes cleanly (200, result=4200); unauthorized tool rejected with TOOL_NOT_FOUND.
actualResult: Tool gateway policy verified: 401 unauthenticated, 19 tools registered, calculator succeeded (4200), unauthorized tool rejected fail-closed (TOOL_NOT_FOUND).

gate: Gate 7: Cross-account execution-run and cancellation rejection
testMethod: Bidirectional IDOR probes on execution runs, cancellation requests, and event streams across Account A and Account B.
expectedResult: All cross-account access attempts returned 404 Not Found; unauthenticated requests returned 401 or 404.
actualResult: Run IDOR quarantine verified: User B -> Run A (read=404, cancel=404, events=404); User A -> Run B (read=404, cancel=404, events=404); unauthenticated read=401.

expectedResult: Active stream under Account A finishes with exact math result (32768) and done event without token leakage or interruption.
actualResult: Concurrent session isolation verified: Account A stream completed cleanly (result=32768) during concurrent Account B sync (status=200).

gate: Gate 9: Session persistence across actual Edge-process restarts
testMethod: Playwright persistentContext launch with msedge channel, full process close and relaunch against artifacts/profiles/edge_profile_raj_gautam.
expectedResult: Session validity, conversations, memory vault, and project items all persist intact across Edge process restart.
actualResult: Edge restart persistence confirmed: sessionValid=true, convCount=1, vaultCount=1, projectCount=1. Screenshots recorded.

gate: Gate 12: PostgreSQL worker fencing, heartbeat failure, and crash recovery
testMethod: Durable worker fencing concurrency test on isolated staging database branch br-snowy-bonus-b32thjlz, worker host heartbeat loss abort test, and crash recovery step state preservation.
expectedResult: Stale fencing token write rejected; valid write accepted (token advances to 4); lost heartbeat triggers prompt abort with HEARTBEAT_FAILED; crash recovery preserves step completion without re-execution.
actualResult: Durable worker resilience verified: worker1 stale write rejected (token 2); worker2 claim succeeded (token 3); worker2 update succeeded (token 4); lost heartbeat aborted execution; step 1 COMPLETED preserved.
